insert into CHB_SEND_CB_TEMP (REGIST_SEQNO) select targetTable.REGIST_SEQNO from ( select ciis.REGIST_SEQNO REGIST_SEQNO, row_number() over() ROWNUM from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB ciis where ciis.SEND_STATUS = '01' and ciis.STATUS != '03'
and ciis.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{holdDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and ciis.regist_seqno not in
#{regist_seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHB_EQU_SUB equTable WHERE equTable.SUBMIT_STATUS IN ('02', '03') AND equTable.REGIST_BANK_CODE = ciis.REGIST_BANK_CODE AND equTable.INDENTIFY_MARK = ciis.INDENTIFY_MARK) and ROWNUM <= #{dataCountPerTime,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ) targetTable
